guidelines: Never log access tokens, refresh tokens, API keys or full request headers.
Calls to third-party APIs must handle 401 (refresh) and 429 (back off) instead of failing the whole sync.
New database tables in Supabase migrations must enable row level security and add at least one policy.
Public functions that change behaviour need a test in the same PR.
Error messages shown to customers must not expose stack traces or internal IDs.

rules.message: Looks like a hard-coded secret. Load it from configuration or a secret store instead.
This log line may print a token or secret. Log the token's presence or last 4 characters only.
Remove debugging console.log, or use the app logger.
TODOs should reference a ticket, e.g. TODO(WXI-123), so they don't get lost.
Disabling RLS exposes the table to every client holding the anon key.
Blocking on a Task (.Result / .Wait()) can deadlock and starves the thread pool. Use await.
